eventDetail.scope: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) and Cyber-Social Systems (CSS) are emerging cross-disciplinary research areas that feature the combination of computational and physical elements. CSS is rapidly evolving due to the popularity of online social networking. With the advent of ubiquitous sensing and networking, future social networks involve cyber-physical interactions among associated social attributes. Cyber-Physical-Social Systems (CPSS) are known as the integration between CPS and CSS.
